en-US: Quick Log: preview contextual suggestions for merchant, amount, account and category. Use the main arrow to fill untouched fields, or expand individual field arrows. Your edited and cleared fields stay protected. Suggestions use local transaction history, date and time; uncertain amounts stay blank. Transfers: enter your own forward or reverse exchange rate and preview the received amount before applying. Please test draft resume, hidden amounts, large text, and currency/account accuracy.
zh-Hans: 快速记账：预览根据情境推荐的商家、金额、账户和分类。点按主箭头填入未修改字段，或展开后逐项选择。保留你已编辑及主动清空的字段。建议依据本机交易历史、日期和时间；金额依据不足时留空。转账：输入自定正向或反向汇率，预览到账金额后应用。请测试草稿恢复、隐藏金额、大字体及币种与账户准确性。
